pullRequest.body:
SIREN's portable desktop transition coordinates Diagrams, Docs, Code and Present in native workspaces with shared appearance, saved sources and offline diagnostics. Python syntax maps include assignment/update nodes and distinguish annotation-only statements. This update adds bounded pure Terminal cwd/profile authorities and fixes the misleading Home backup-cancellation error action.

Validation for frozen local head `96282fb2f63a12d46104ee35161f0339062f15c3` (source commits `356618535ad39bc9b45518ae36ab4dba3a02356c` and `7cb9d2c5ab121d3a4a31feaa2390f03720cd14dd`):
- Full local suite: 1,723 passed; 667 captured inputs unchanged.
- Actual development Home: 4 cases complete, including OS cancellation and Lock; 663 inputs unchanged.
- Separate portable preview: 305 exact ASAR members; 3 copied programmes, 23 cases complete; 9 post-exit archive/runtime/helper checks and 668 inputs unchanged.
- Independently authored Terminal adversarial, Home VM and package byte/receipt reviews are retained with explicit authors and limits. The original quadratic-path OOM finding and both reviewers' adverse oracle/schema attempts remain unchanged; corrected follow-ups are separate. Review of package receipts does not claim independent GUI execution.

Original hosted runs [37640219262](https://github.com/Kellas94/siren/actions/runs/37640219262) and [37647458513](https://github.com/Kellas94/siren/actions/runs/37647458513) remain FINAL FAILURE with their original logs/artifacts retained. The latter demonstrated that normal Home cancellation produced an unwanted Explain error action; the local/copy fix above addresses it without weakening the cancellation assertion. Historical Lock/pan causes remain open. New original hosted run [37654899907](https://github.com/Kellas94/siren/actions/runs/37654899907) is pending; it is not an approval or PASS.

The sync changes 125 canonical blobs (120 additions, 5 modifications), preserves 2,158 untouched blobs, the exact existing ignore prefix and canonical byte-exact attributes/HTML rules. Original execution logs remain exact bytes.

The Data roadmap records a future visual flow builder, inspectable generated code, pivots/joins/automation and financial-risk workflows with a 100M+ row benchmark target. This is a requirements roadmap, not an implemented Data engine or demonstrated capacity. Python contextual learning and an optional offline official manual also remain proposals.

This remains an open draft development preview. Native Terminal execution is NOT_ADMITTED; the pure authorities are intentionally excluded from the portable package and activate no shell/IPC/UI. No production release, installed-app replacement, account/update activation, Data execution or AI tutor is claimed.
